name: Dragonhide Belt, +3

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Regain Focus
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): regain 1d8 Focus Points.

summary: +3 to the save DC of your Monk features; once a day, regain 1d8 Focus Points.
text: This finely stitched belt is made from dragonhide. While wearing it, you gain a +3 bonus to the saving throw DCs of your Monk features that use Focus Points. In addition, you can take a Magic action to regain a number of expended Focus Points equal to a roll of 1d8. You can't use this action again until the next dawn.
